rules.description: A TCP/5000 frame contains LOGIN bytes; framing and authentication are checked by the application tests.
A TCP/5000 frame contains MSG bytes; verify the complete message and recipients separately.
A TCP/5000 frame contains EVENT bytes; correlate its direction, event type and recipient.

manual_checks: R1 R2: Match SYN/SYN-ACK/ACK to the same flow.
R3 R4 R5: Reassemble the declared framing and assert identities, message text and intended recipients.
R6: Correlate the application close response, presence event and transport teardown.
